expressions.cue: A timetable identifies one service as Flight 3. Write its short flight-number label using 便, without 第; this is not a count of departures. For writing, use kanji or Arabic numerals.
expressions.explanation: 三便 here identifies one numbered service. Flight labels and actual counts can have the same written shape; this elementary example does not prescribe every airline's multi-digit or radio-call pronunciation.

expressions.cue: A route has two scheduled departures in one day. Write only the service count using 便, not an aircraft count or flight identifier. For writing, use kanji or Arabic numerals.
expressions.explanation: 二便 counts two scheduled services. It does not establish the number of distinct aircraft, since the same aircraft may operate more than one service.
